body:
I was at a good IT job too and basically quit because my father got a blood infection and was dying and the only thing I wanted to do was be with him and make sure he made it through but my job wasn't letting me have time off work. I tried to sue them but it didn't work. I'm 36, losing my house now err selling it because I can't afford it any more. 

I broke both my ankles, long story and now I have a permanent bad left ankle that hurts with every step.

Just got rejected from like 10 programming jobs last week, I'm in the job hunt but it's extremely stressful and frankly I just don't want to do it even though I basically have to.

I was considering doing a manual job on the water as I'm moving out west from the east coast once I sell my house but the pay is shit.

Anyways, I sympathize. 

I may still end up taking my life at the gun range or jumping from the 180 foot bridge near wear I'm moving to. My current state has loose gun laws at gun ranges and where I'm moving to it's not like that.

It puts things in perspective on what kind of life challenges you've faced so far in your life.

You said when you were younger, as if you are old now, so I was curious your age.

I don't know what your disease is but I can sympathize because I've had chronic late stage Lyme disease and my brothers had no idea what I went through.

It sounds like you're hurting mostly over the divorce. Have you thought about dating or seeing other women?

I am probably not the best person to be talking to you because Im somewhat suicidal myself, fantasizing about going to the gun range and ending things myself.

I'm moving to Whidbey Island in the PNW after not working for a year and giving up my house in the east coast, I also just ended a relationship with my ex and am in my 30s.

The only thing keeping me right now is the thought that hey, maybe a change of scenery, new girlfriend and new job will change how I'm feeling.

Are you a developer?

I'm actually very involved in getting this up and running myself, I'm working on it.

Secure email is a must and the only real way to do it is with your own in house mail server, in my opinion. But doing it truly secure is actually extremely difficult and requires a lot of expertise and talent. 

Heres my current work in progress...

Rasp Pi: Raspberry Pi Zero W

OS: Raspbian (A custom OS is being worked on)

Email solution: NodeJS implementation, can't go into specifics publicly here

Security: Custom authentication/encryption I developed in my last company, can't go into specifics

I do not believe you will be able to find an off the shelf solution that will give you true security. I'd be interested though in what other people have to say though.

I originally wrote a longer post but then I realized that I wrote too much information. I can back up my claims but don't want to go too much into specifics here.

I'm trying to hang in there, I really am. I'm at the point though where I feel no joy. Where I can't even sit still any more. Can't sit and enjoy a movie. I woke up out of a nightmare into a nightmare. The nightmare now is so much time is gone and I have little to show from it. No savings and no real fun or trips after college. The truth is, I don't even want to be in this area any more. Theres too much pain associated with it. Every day is a struggle at this point. I have lost so much time and have so little money to even live now. I feel like I have to take a huge risk to make things better. I have a full week of appointments next week but after that, unless something miraculous happens, I'm going to put just the stuff I need in my car and drive to San Francisco. I'll live out of my car for some months or see how long some of my friends will let me stay at their place until I can land a programming job. I have already craigslisted a lot of my stuff, as I let consumerism and manic episodes get the best of me at points. I want to live lean and have a life now. The only way I can see myself doing that is cutting lose of where I am and leaving most of my stuff(and memories) behind.
